question: does ramapo have an MBA program
answer:
Yes. Ramapo offers the Business Administration MBA, a Master of Business Administration, through the Anisfield School of Business. [1][5] The college describes it as an AACSB-accredited, 42-credit, 20-month cohort program with a fall start only. [6][9]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-MBA-MBAD) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/home/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/home/)

question: what is the 4+1 program and which majors offer it
answer:
A 4+1 lets students begin a master’s program while completing their bachelor’s degree, then finish the master’s in one additional year after earning the four-year bachelor’s degree—a five-year program. [1][2]

The catalog lists these 4+1 programs: Accounting, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Public Policy, and Special Education. [3] The descriptions say the Computer Science 4+1 and Applied Mathematics 4+1 are designed for students enrolled in Computer Science BS, Data Science BS, or Mathematics BS. Students in other disciplines may contact the Graduate Program Director about designing a five-year plan. [1][2] The catalog lists no bachelor’s major named “4+1.” [3]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-PMCS) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-PAPM) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: Im a junior in business admin. if I do the accelerated bachelors/masters how many grad credits count toward both degrees?
answer:
The catalog lists no bachelor's major or graduate program for “accelerated grad” [14], so these pages don’t establish a specific accelerated bachelor’s/master’s option for Business Administration. For students accepted into a 4+1 program, graduate courses appear on both transcripts and apply toward undergraduate requirements; after graduating and matriculating in a Ramapo graduate program, students may also use them toward graduate requirements, if applicable [7]. The page gives no fixed number of credits that count toward both degrees. Ask the Anisfield School of Business (asb@ramapo.edu; (201) 684-7379) about your program [7].

Sources: [7](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#undergraduate-students-taking-graduate-courses) [14](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: are there any graduate certificates? I already have a bachelors and dont want a full masters
answer:
Yes. The catalog lists these graduate certificates:
• Business Foundations – Graduate Certificate (Anisfield School of Business): 12 credits, with six required courses: ACCT 510 FOUNDATIONS OF ACCOUNTING; BADM 510 FOUNDATION STATS FOR BUSINESS; ECON 510 FOUNDATIONS OF ECONOMICS; FINC 510 FOUNDATIONS OF FINANCE; MGMT 510 FOUNDATIONS OF MANAGEMENT; and MKTG 510 FOUNDATIONS OF MARKETING. [1]
• Data Analyst – Graduate Certificate (School of Science, Nursing, and Health): two required courses, DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE and DATA 670 DATA VISUALIZATION, plus one elective: BADM 501 DATA ANALYTICS or MBAD 615 BUSINESS ANALYTICS. [2]
The catalog lists graduate certificates separately from graduate degree programs. A graduate certificate must require at least 9 credits beyond the Bachelor’s level. [3][4]
For details, contact the Anisfield School of Business at asb@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7379 [1], or the School of Science, Nursing, and Health Office at SNHOffice@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7734 [2].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-GCR-BUFN) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-GCR-DTAN) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#certificate-programs1)

question: how many total credits do you need to graduate with a bachelor's degree at Ramapo
answer:
Ramapo’s general minimum for a bachelor’s degree is 128 credits that count toward graduation [10]. The Registrar FAQ also says 128 credits overall, but notes that program requirements differ [5]; the Registrar’s graduation page says at least 128 credits [6]. Specific degree programs may require more [10].

You must also complete at least 32 credits at Ramapo and your final 32 credits in residence [10]. The Registrar’s page separately specifies at least 48 credits at Ramapo, including the final 32 in residence [6]; the pages differ on the Ramapo-credit minimum. The catalog says the final 32 may be at Ramapo or in a Ramapo-approved study abroad program or experience [9].

For your program’s exact requirements, review credits and classes with your adviser [5, 8]. The Registrar’s office is in D-224; reg@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7695 [5].

Sources: [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/faq/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/graduation-commencement/) [9](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#undergraduate-residency-requirement1) [10](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#graduation-requirements)

question: What courses are required for the business administration major, and is there a concentration in finance?
answer:
The catalog lists the bachelor’s majors in business administration as Healthcare Administration BS and International Business BA; it does not list a Business Administration major. [15] Finance is listed as a separate BS major, not as a concentration in Business Administration. The Finance BS is offered by the Anisfield School of Business; its published requirements are: [1]
- Select 1: MATH 108, MATH 110, or MATH 121.
- ASB required courses: ACCT 221, ACCT 222, BADM 223, BADM 225, BADM 495, ECON 101, ECON 102, FINC 301, INFO 224, MGMT 302, MGMT 370, MKTG 290.
- Select 1 International Category course: ECON 323, ECON 325, HNRS 220, IBUS 321, IBUS 322, IBUS 326, IBUS 305, IBUS 335, IBUS 336, or IBUS 340.
- Select 1 Ethics course: BADM 301, HNRS 325, or INFO 315.
- Major required: FINC 302 and FINC 321.
- Select 4 electives from ECON 310, FINC 303, FINC 305, FINC 310, FINC 313, FINC 315, FINC 318, FINC 320, FINC 321, FINC 322, FINC 325, FINC 330, FINC 340, FINC 360, FINC 406, FINC 411, FINC 415, or FINC 426.
- Required Career Pathways: PATH 001, PATH 002, PATH 003.
The Finance program also publishes a Finance Minor. [1]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-BS-FNCE) [15](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: does econ 101 count for gen ed or just for the business major
answer:
ECON 101 has no Gen Ed attribute in the catalog [2], so it does not count as an approved Gen Ed course. It is a required course for the Economics BA major [1]. ECON 101 is 4 credits; its prerequisite is CRWT 102 or CRWT 102S, and it may be taken concurrently [2]. The catalog lists International Business BA as the bachelor's major titled “just business” [14]. For help confirming how a course applies to your own degree, contact the Anisfield School of Business at asb@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7379 [2].

question: should I do the MS in data science or the MBA if I want to get into management? which one is better
answer:
There isn’t verified information here that says which degree is better for you—that depends on your goals. The pages do say the MBA is a 42-credit, 20-month cohort program focused on preparing graduates for “management and senior level careers in business”; it has a fall start only [5]. The MS in Data Science is described as preparing graduates for data-science work, and says data science supports decisions across business sectors [2]. The catalog lists Data Science MS and Computer Science MS as graduate programs for “data science” [15].

For help choosing, Graduate Admissions invites prospective graduate students to schedule an appointment with a Graduate Admissions Counselor to discuss career-path questions. Email graduate@ramapo.edu [7].
